</strong><strong>+ 6 luxury rooms for a perfect mix of privacy and family atmosphere<br />
+ The perfect location to combine Kitesurfing, Surfing &amp; SUP<br />
+ Just in the middle: Buzzing Lagos and secluded nature places<br />
+ Beach in 700m walking distance from the kitesurf camp<br />
+ Supermarket, ATM, 15+ restaurants and several bars just around the corner<br />
+ Pizza night, outoor cinema and other events at the logde<br />
</strong><strong>+ <a href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/packages/">Amazing discounted packages </a>and countless <a href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/activities-algarve-lagos/">activities</a></strong></p>
<p>A place where modern day pirates mingle with nomadic mermaids, where freshwater sailors meet old salt dogs, where well-travelled treasure hunters socialize with passport stamp collectors. A place where the seafaring tribes of boardsport enthusiasts meet:<strong> Welcome to the Ocean Spirits Kite, Surf &amp; SUP Lodge.<br />
</strong></p>
